title: YgoDuelist card_database import row
description: One logical card for export into C# CanonicalVars + YgoDuelist localization. cardId must match CustomCardModel id entry (YGODUELIST-<CLASS_NAME>).

descriptionTemplate.description: Base attack-mode text; use {Damage}, {Mgc}, … matching varBindings

varBindings.description: Maps DynamicVar name to numeric base (e.g. Mgc, Mgc2, Damage). Omitted names use C# defaults from the card class.

sourceRowId.description: Optional id from cards_database.json for traceability
